correctness.rationale: For an unselected vertex the three neighbor bits must include both 0 and 1. Legal length-n closed walks of the pair-state transfer are in bijection with labelled configurations, so the trace is the size polynomial, with no division by n. Independent exact determinant checks and the formal trace–determinant identity recover both polynomials. With x=u/t and z=t² the determinants have no negative t powers; the t⁰, t¹ and t² coefficients of their log derivatives give the stated minima and multiplicities, including 39 restrained minima at n=6. The equality at lines 110–111 has a formal length-two error: the rational expression equals the indicated sum minus 2u², so all claimed coefficients for n≥4 are unaffected. With two omitted vertices, validity is exactly adjacency of the omitted pair, giving 3n; with one omitted vertex the complement condition fails. Both unweighted directed transfers are strongly connected with a loop and the restrained matrix is strictly smaller entrywise somewhere. Primitivity and the trace identify simple leading eigenvalues, strict spectral comparison gives r>d, and the ratio has prefactor one. Thus the scoped findings are correct despite the noted out-of-scope algebra error.
residual_risks: The transfer algebra includes formal small lengths that need not correspond to the stipulated simple graphs. In particular the infinite sum at lines 110–111 must not be extrapolated at length two.

originality.rationale: The matched same-day Möbius record gives the exact plus and minus factors B and A of the identical transfer matrix, and expressly identifies the trace without its row-swap operator as the untwisted circular-ladder count. Replacing the signed trace by its sum therefore gives the entire restrained polynomial without recalculation. Both the minimum data and special boundary coefficients are consequences of this covered polynomial. The ordinary domination polynomial and in particular the exact unweighted denominator are already tabulated in OEIS; the 2017 formula there for total prism counts equals −x Q′(x)/Q(x) with Q=(1+x²)p_d exactly. Thus the comparator counts (also covered at minimum weight by Allagan) and the ratio rate are extracted from two already available exact series by routine coefficient and dominant-root arguments. No ordering is inferred from the common date of the two restrained findings.
residual_risks: The two restrained census records share a date; the verified implication does not establish priority. The database overlap is specifically on the ordinary side, not a claimed direct listing there of restrained coefficients.
